name: Spectrogram
summary: The spectrum over time, scrolling: every frequency's loudness as colour. Linear shows the highs in detail, where some tracks hide pictures.
credit: The classic scrolling spectrogram and waterfall display. Written fresh.
hint: Time runs across (or up or down), frequency the other way; brightness is loudness. Linear gives every hertz the same room, so pictures drawn into a track's highs (DOOM's pentagrams) show; log gives every octave the same, as ears hear it. Floor hides the quiet, Gain brightens the rest.

params.label: Scroll
params.help: Left: the newest sound at the right edge, moving left. Up and Down: a waterfall, the newest at the bottom or the top.

params.label: Lowest
params.help: On the log axis, at least 20 Hz.

params.label: Colours
params.help: Palette: the layer's palette from quiet to loud. Heat: black through violet and orange to pale yellow. Mono: the layer's colour by brightness.

params.label: Floor
params.help: How quiet a frequency must be to show black (0.3 is -56 dB).

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Brightness is the level to this power: higher darkens the quiet more.
